verdict.rationale: Devin's API and MCP server let users create sessions, manage playbooks/knowledge, set schedules, and query repo docs programmatically, covering much of the core session-management workflow available in the UI, and even allow acting on behalf of other users. However, there's no evidence the API/MCP exposes UI-only features like interactive browser takeover, Slack/Teams tagging, or the embedded IDE handoff, and probes show no public OpenAPI spec, suggesting incomplete or undocumented parity. Missing for 10: confirmation that interactive browser, IDE takeover, and Slack/Teams integrations are API-accessible, plus a public OpenAPI spec proving full endpoint coverage.
